test_title: PYST 54: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to

form a meaningful sentence.

(P) an open mind

(Q) seek it with

(O) for personal growth and development

(R) knowledge is a powerful tool
solution:
The correct answer is '**option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sequence of the jumbled parts to form a meaningful sentence is ROQP.
 
• The sentence formed is: "Knowledge is a powerful tool for personal growth and development, seek it with an open mind."

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **R**: "Knowledge is a powerful tool" introduces the subject.
 
• **O**: "for personal growth and development" explains the purpose of the subject.
 
• **Q**: "seek it with" starts the next clause explaining how to approach the subject.
 
• **P**: "an open mind" completes the idea of the approach mentioned in Q.
